statements.proposition: The change keeps the Elasticsearch source working, with the same legacy-template ingestion, on older clusters that only have legacy index templates.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: Settled by reading the diff only (no cluster available, tests not run): legacy get_template() path and its properties are preserved, and the new composable call is isolated in try/except so a failure on older clusters (no get_index_template) is only logged. Not run against a real old cluster.
evidence: Diff elastic_search.py: legacy loop kept (get_template(), _extract_mcps(template, is_index=False)); composable fetch added inside 'try: ... except Exception as e: logger.warning(...)'

Diff: for legacy (is_composable False) _get_template_metadata still returns get_template(name=...)[name]; _extract_template_custom_properties reads root-level aliases/settings/index_patterns as before; mappings lookup now .get('mappings', {}) (more lenient than before)
Only modified files: elastic_search.py and tests/unit/test_elasticsearch_source.py
